shared.name: init
shared.description: Use when the project context (product, identity, architecture, declared scopes) must be captured or completed.

shared.name: handoff
shared.description: Use when a session ends and its state must be handed over to the next session.

shared.name: dynamic-workflow
shared.description: Invoke ONLY when user types /aos:dynamic-workflow with a free-form request that should be decomposed and run as a parallel multi-agent workflow.

shared.name: dynamic-authoring
shared.description: Use when tasks of a plan must be authored and reviewed as a skill, agent or command through the dynamic authoring pipeline; takes plan task ids.

shared.name: config
shared.description: Re-render provider configuration for the active session. Use after editing adapter templates, hooks.json, or agents/skills without restarting; give a template name to re-render only that template.

shared.name: compile
shared.description: Compile capability artifacts (agents, skills, commands) and the hook wiring from source into provider config dir. Run after modifying agents, skills, commands, or hooks.

shared.name: plan
shared.description: Use when a plan must be drafted for the backlog items of this session or the active plan must be amended; takes a backlog item id or the request to amend.

shared.name: concept
shared.description: Use when what a piece of work has to settle before a plan exists must be captured as a concept from the developer's raw input; takes the input or the name of an existing concept to continue.

shared.name: bash-authoring
shared.description: Use when tasks of a plan must be written and reviewed as bash code, one or a group of related ones, be it a library function, module command or adapter; takes plan task ids.

shared.name: spec
shared.description: Use when the tasks of one plan must be turned into a specification of requirements, or an existing specification must be continued; takes an optional plan id and an optional specification name.

shared.name: roadmap
shared.description: Use when the project needs its first roadmap, a new area, milestone or release, or a change to one; takes the mode init, add or edit.

shared.name: planning
shared.description: Use when a project has no roadmap or backlog yet, or when it is unclear where the planning stands: creates the first planning files and shows the status, or points at the listing of one planning artifact.

shared.name: plan-review
shared.description: Use when a written plan must be reviewed against the code before its tasks are authored, or after an amend; takes an optional plan id and an optional lens.

shared.name: backlog
shared.description: Use when an item must be added to the backlog, or the title, goal or milestone of an item changed; takes the mode add or edit.

shared.name: hook-authoring
shared.description: Use when tasks of a plan must be written and reviewed as hook scripts, one hook per task; takes plan task ids.

shared.name: start
shared.description: Use when work on a new change starts and it needs its own branch.

shared.name: rules-sync
shared.description: Use when the branch rules of the repository must follow bin/config/rulesets.yaml or the stage changes.

shared.name: release
shared.description: Use when master holds changes of a component that are ready to be released.

shared.name: promote
shared.description: Use when a release is made and the release branch has to follow its tag.

shared.name: pr
shared.description: Use when a feature branch is committed and ready for review as a pull request.

shared.name: commit
shared.description: Use when changes on a feature branch are ready to be committed with a conventional message.

shared.name: check
shared.description: Use before a pull request or a push, and to see which component is red.

shared.name: split
shared.description: Use when a component with its own child repository has changes or releases that the child has to receive.

shared.name: stage
shared.description: Use when the project moves between development and production, or the live master ruleset may differ from the stage expected.
